scoring: Explicit source/span meaning labels. Report mean correct changed-word depth, clean useful messages, material/scope errors at10/25/50 and bylength; distinguish reference-inherited versus introduced errors.
advancement_criterion: Primary arm: at least56/80 clean useful messages, no more than2/80 material-or-scope-error messages, at least8% mean correct changed-word depth; also improve current control correct depth by5percentagepoints or clean useful messages by8/80 without more errors. Report uncertainty and every threshold miss; these are not store-release or all-language acceptance criteria.
cost_policy: Actual native route/first-owner-invocation and immediate warm-repeat captured separately. Strong-reference first-process preparation and per-message CPUlatency measured, not mobile qualification.
